_doc: Two MCP servers: 'agentii' data plane (replicated byte-identically from contracts/mcp-canonical.json per FR-010 / Round 4 Q15) and 'agentii-office' office plane (declared ONLY here per FR-040). The office plane authenticates via the same AGENTII_API_KEY (FR-045) but counts against a separate office_calls_per_day quota tier (spec-022 T093).
_tool_alias_map_doc: Per FR-043a plugin-level binding: 9-tool surface (8 active v1.0 + xlsx.edit v1.1 reserved). Skills reference abstract names; deployment manifests resolve to concrete MCP tools. agent.yaml and ~/.agentii/config.toml MAY override.
